desc: 浅灰蓝布艺L型转角沙发，配板岩灰蓝墙客厅成套软装与定制流程
leaf: 浅灰蓝布艺L型转角沙发
name: 灰蓝布艺转角贵妃沙发定制款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒讲清「转角沙发加整面背景墙软装一次配齐」的定制定位，用中调灰蓝客厅与真实挂画地毯让人代入自己家。
shots.textZone: 左上留白：小字英文 kicker，主标题「{selling_point_1}」两行白色，其下一行细字「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 干净的白底单品主图，把转角比例、贵妃位朝向、扶手profile与细金属脚一次看清，负责搜索流量的一眼点击。
shots.textZone: 顶部通栏 #1C1F24 色带内一行主标「{selling_point_2}」，不叠加任何其它文字

shots.intent: 同机位俯视分屏放大「单件买回来墙角还是空、尺寸不合还挡道」的真实痛点，逼出成套转角定制需求。
shots.textZone: 顶部通栏 #1C1F24 色带一行主标「{selling_point_3}」，两格底角各一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 低机位实景把转角放回可坐可躺的日常现场，用圆几、地毯与绿植给出人体尺度，让买家代入下班后的客厅。
shots.textZone: 左下角一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，不加其它文字

shots.intent: 微距证明织物织法、坐垫明线与靠包缝线的做工一致性，把材质与耐久疑虑落到可见证据上。
shots.textZone: 右侧留白带：小标题「{selling_point_4}」与其下一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，1px 引线指向明线

shots.intent: 贴地仰视把转角模块连接位、贵妃榻底座离地高度与金属脚落地接触做实，证明结构稳定与清洁可通过性。
shots.textZone: 底部一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，以 1px 引线连到连接位

shots.intent: 同墙同光同框对比只放直排位与加上贵妃位后的落地占位，让买家自己判断开间够不够，把尺寸焦虑一次解决。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_5}」，两格底角各一枚小标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把咨询、下定、量尺、方案、生产到上门安装的六步流程排成一眼可读的清单，讲清交付路径消除流程焦虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部 #1C1F24 色带主标「{selling_point_6}」；六枚裸排粗体编号 01-06 各配一枚圆形细线图标与短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_6}」

shots.intent: 把源页的定制案例展示改成同一件沙发在三种风格语境下的三联实景，让买家先认领风格再谈配置。
shots.textZone: 每格底缘一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，同一条对齐基线，不叠加其它文字

shots.intent: 用四项服务保障加一张通用规格表把「包含什么、参数是什么」摊开，用透明结构而不是空洞承诺降风险。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_7}」；四枚圆形图标各配短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」；下方规格表行名为通用词，数值一律为占位符「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位收口，把整页情绪落回可坐可躺的日常客厅，再给一个明确的咨询量尺动作。
shots.textZone: 下方四分之一留白：主标「{selling_point_1}」，其下一枚直角方形按钮，填色 #D9A926，内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real living room with a mid-tone slate blue-grey wall #75808D over a pale marble-look floor #D8D5CF, a seamless paper off-white studio field #F1F1EE or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, and full-width near-black charcoal copy bands #1C1F24 with one offset charcoal rectangle framing a photograph as the recurring graphic device; right-angle corners throughout, no rounded cards, one clean copy zone per screen and never busy decor
style.direction: slate-blue whole-room custom soft-furnishing commerce, mid-tone graphic interior with charcoal copy bands rather than airy daylight or dark editorial
style.iconSystem: 2px circular-framed monoline pictograms with one small solid glyph inside, drawn in #1C1F24 on light fields and #F1F1EE on slate fields, plus oversized bold bare numerals 01-06 in #1C1F24 with no chips and no containers, maximum six per screen, 1px hairline rules for tables; no filled illustration, no 3D badges, no gradient seals, no pill labels
style.lightingSystem: neutral indoor mixed light at 4000-4300K: a soft window source off camera left plus two shallow elliptical ceiling downlight pools washing the slate wall above the seating, one grounded contact shadow under the sofa only, wide gentle falloff, controlled soft speculars and no hotspots; this is deliberately NOT a cool 6500K north-daylight wash and NOT a dark low-key raking editorial grade; every piece sits on a visible contact shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent slate-blue whole-room custom soft-furnishing visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mid-tone slate blue-grey wall #75808D, near-black charcoal copy bands #1C1F24, paper off-white #F1F1EE, upholstery taken unchanged from the reference pale blue-grey #C6CCD1, and two accents only, mustard #D9A926 and petrol teal #1E7FA8; neutral indoor grade, deliberately not a cool 6500K north-daylight wash and not a dark brass editorial grade; one heavy bold geometric sans-serif family for Chinese headlines plus the same family at light weight for labels and numerals, with small letter-spaced uppercase English kickers and all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short; backgrounds limited to a real living room with a mid-tone slate blue-grey wall #75808D over a pale marble-look floor #D8D5CF, a seamless paper off-white studio field #F1F1EE or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, and full-width charcoal bands #1C1F24 with one offset charcoal rectangle framing a photograph, all at right-angle corners with one clean copy zone per screen; lighting always neutral indoor mixed light at 4000-4300K, a soft window source off camera left plus two shallow elliptical ceiling downlight pools washing the wall above the seating, one grounded contact shadow under the sofa, wide gentle falloff and no hotspots; surface system of matte woven upholstery exactly as supplied, pale marble-look floor, a matte low-pile geometric triangle rug in lilac-blue #A8AECB, grey #B9BCC4, mustard #E4C96A and white #F2F2EF, and matte black metal #23262A; layout system of 2px circular-framed monoline pictograms, oversized bold bare numerals 01-06 in #1C1F24 with no chips, 1px hairline table rules and consistent right-angle corners; product presentation rules: identical scale, low flat arm profile, cushion count, chaise side, topstitched seam pattern and slim tapered black metal leg form in every frame, seated on the floor with a contact shadow, corrected straight verticals and a real furnishing as scale anchor, the slight 3/4 seated angle reused across scene screens; no color palette changes, no recoloured or re-woven upholstery, no added or removed chaise, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented dimensions, fabric or foam grades, board specs, eco ratings, hardware brands, warranty terms or certificates, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges, no prices, no people.
noDrift: no recoloured, re-woven or re-tufted upholstery, no vinyl or leather look
no added or removed chaise module, no invented headrest, quilting, piping or buttons
no inconsistent lighting direction, no missing downlight pools and no contradictory shadow lengths
no mismatched icon or numeral styles
no drift toward a cool 6500K nordic daylight grade or a dark brass editorial grade
no invented dimensions, fabric or foam densities, board grades, eco ratings, hardware brands, warranty years, price per square metre or certificates
no brand mark, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price, no contact details
no people, no hands and no visible faces; any reused figure must be anonymous and cropped
style.presentationRules: the sectional keeps one proportional scale, the same low flat arm profile, the same seat and back cushion count, the same chaise side, the same topstitched seam pattern and the same slim tapered black metal leg form in every frame; it stands on the floor with a real contact shadow and never floats; interior verticals, wall corners, picture frames and floor lines stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (rug, round coffee table, open shelf, plant on a stand) always anchors human scale; the slight 3/4 seated angle of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room
style.surfaceSystem: matte woven upholstery rendered exactly as supplied in pale blue-grey #C6CCD1, pale marble-look floor #D8D5CF with a soft sheen, matte low-pile geometric triangle rug in lilac-blue #A8AECB, grey #B9BCC4, mustard #E4C96A and white #F2F2EF, matte black metal #23262A open shelving, matte paper and charcoal graphic fields; never gloss lacquer, never vinyl or leather sheen
style.typography: one heavy bold geometric sans-serif family for Chinese headlines set in #F1F1EE on charcoal bands and in #1C1F24 on light fields, plus the same family at light weight for labels, numerals and dimension words; small letter-spaced uppercase English kicker lines only, two weights of one family, never a serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon face; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-32pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-12pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters
